one_line: Chahamana king of Ajmer (r. c. 1135–1150 CE), hydraulic innovator who created the Ana Sagar lake and died by parricide.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, medium-tall and solidly built, with the presence of a seasoned warrior-king who has spent time both in battle and supervising construction works.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, medium wheatish complexion typical of Rajasthan, straight sharp nose, neatly trimmed mustache and short close beard, a faint vertical scar on the left cheek, eyes slightly narrow and intense with a default expression of calm, calculating focus that softens into quiet pride when he surveys his imagined lake.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair with a few subtle gray strands at the temples, worn to just above the shoulders and combed back; he wears a simple but elegant red rajput-style cloth turban (pagri) wrapped low and firm, with a single small gold kalgi plume and a narrow white band at the base.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length quilted cotton angarakha in muted off-white with fine red block-printed floral motifs and side-tie cords, over which sits a fitted reddish-brown leather-and-cotton brigandine-style coat with visible brass rivet heads; a broad deep-indigo cotton patka (waist sash) with thin gold borders is wrapped tightly at his waist, from which hangs a small utility pouch; his lower garment is a pair of loose churidar-style trousers in dusty beige that gather cleanly at the ankles; on his feet are sturdy brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes; he also wears a simple hammered gold armlet on his right upper arm, a pair of modest gold stud earrings, and a short, practical shawl of light grey wool folded over his left shoulder, its edge showing a narrow red border, all textiles looking travel-worn but well-kept.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved Rajput sword (talwar) with a brass hilt and disc pommel sheathed at his left hip, and in his right hand a detailed rolled parchment plan tied with a red cord, its surface faintly showing sketched outlines of a lake and embankments.

ref_desc: Arnoraja is a medium-tall, wheatish-complexioned Rajput king in a red turban with a small gold plume, shoulder-length black hair, off-white patterned angarakha, reddish-brown riveted coat, beige churidar, deep-indigo sash, brown mojari shoes, carrying a brass-hilted talwar and a rolled parchment plan, with gold accents.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model sheet of Arnoraja, a medium-tall, solidly built Rajput king in his early 40s with an oval face, wheatish complexion, straight nose, a neat mustache with short beard and a faint scar on his left cheek, eyes calm and focused; his black shoulder-length hair shows a little gray at the temples and is mostly hidden under a simple red Rajput cloth turban with a small gold plume and a narrow white band at the base. He wears a knee-length muted off-white cotton angarakha with fine red block-printed floral motifs, tied at the side, over which sits a fitted reddish-brown leather-and-cotton brigandine-style coat with visible brass rivets; a broad deep-indigo waist sash with thin gold borders is wrapped firmly around his waist and holds a small utility pouch. His loose dusty beige churidar trousers gather neatly at the ankles above sturdy brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes; a short light grey wool shawl with a narrow red edge is folded over his left shoulder. Simple gold studs in his ears and a single gold armlet on his right upper arm add restrained royal elegance. At his left hip hangs a sheathed long slightly curved Rajput talwar with a brass hilt and disc pommel, while his right hand holds a rolled parchment plan tied with a red cord, faintly marked with the outlines of a lake and embankments; use a grounded palette of muted off-white, deep indigo blue, dusty beige, reddish brown, and gold, and show him from multiple angles to emphasize this exact face, hair, costume, and equipment.
